# Trace library · people (the marks someone carries, never their looks)

This file holds only **checkable marks left by what a person chose, did, or lived through**: what they wear, where the wear is, where a tan line breaks, how long since the last shave, which edge of the sole went first.

It holds no physiognomy, no ethnicity, no health, no sexual orientation, no looks. The test is simple: did this mark come from something they **did**, or from how they were **born**? The second kind never goes in.

56 entries. To add one: edit `src/traces/`, run `pnpm build:skill && pnpm test`, open a PR.

## bag

- **bag.keychain**: What hangs on the keychain → Car key brand: owns a car, tier readable (strong); Many access cards: commutes through several buildings (medium); Tools (opener, knife, USB stick): practical type (medium)
- **bag.everyday-carry**: Bag contents laid out: power bank, earbuds, tissues, umbrella → Long commute (power bank, earbuds) (medium); Always carries an umbrella: rainy city, or learned the hard way (weak)

## hands

- **hands.ring-mark-no-ring**: A pale band or indentation at the base of the ring finger, with no ring on it → Wore a ring for a long time and took it off recently (strong); Job requires removing jewelry: clinical, food, machining, lifting (medium)
  - ⚠️ State only that a ring is usually worn and is off now; never infer relationship status or judge it
- **hands.string-callus**: Hard calluses on four fingertips of one hand only → Plays a string instrument: guitar, bass, ukulele, erhu (strong)
- **hands.nails-short-one-hand**: Nails cut extremely short on one hand only → The fretting hand of a guitarist (classical players keep the picking nails long) (strong); Climbing or gymnastics (medium)
- **hands.tape-residue-knuckles**: Fingers taped, or chalk residue on the hands → Rock climbing or bouldering (strong); Weightlifting, gymnastics, boxing (medium)
- **hands.palm-bar-callus**: A row of calluses across the base of the fingers; thick web of the thumb → Regular barbell, pull-up bar or machine work (strong); Manual tool work: hauling, carpentry, gardening (medium)
- **hands.ink-side-of-hand**: Ink or graphite smudged along the outer edge of the little finger → Writes left-handed: the hand drags across fresh ink (strong); Handwriting on a tablet, or heavy note-taking (medium)
- **hands.stained-fingertips**: Colour that will not wash out of the fingertips or nail beds (paint, dye, grease, turmeric) → Hands-on trade: hairdressing, painting, repair, kitchen work (medium); A recent one-off: dyeing hair, decorating, cooking (medium)
- **hands.dry-knuckles**: Cracked, peeling skin over the knuckles and around the nails → Washes hands many times a day: clinical, food service, childcare, lab (medium); Dry cold climate or long hours outdoors (medium)
  - ⚠️ Infer setting and frequency only; never any health or mental-state inference
- **hands.watch-tan**: A clear watch-strap tan line on the wrist → Wears the same watch daily and spends real time outdoors (strong)
- **hands.beeswax**: Soft hands that smell of beeswax ointment → Surgeon: constant scrubbing cracks the skin; beeswax ointment repairs it (strong)
  - applies to: historical case · source: Elementary S1E1
- **hands.pen-callus**: Callus on the inside of the middle finger → Holds a pen for hours: student, teacher, artist (medium)

## face

- **face.nose-pad-marks**: Symmetrical red dents on the bridge of the nose, but no glasses on → Just removed glasses that are worn all day (strong)
- **face.sunglass-tan**: A sharp pale mask around the eyes against a tanned face → Long outdoor sessions in sunglasses: cycling, running, skiing, field sports (strong)
- **face.helmet-strap-mark**: A strap mark along the jaw or cheekbone, hair flattened at the temples → Just took off a helmet: cycling, motorcycle, site work, sport (strong)
- **face.mask-line**: Marks behind the ears, or a mask-shaped tone line across the face → Long stretch in a mask: commute, clinical, industrial, dusty work (strong)
- **face.stubble-length**: Length of stubble and how sharply it is edged → Roughly how long since the last shave; a crisp edge means a day or two (strong); Very crisp edges suggest a barber rather than a home shave (medium)
  - ⚠️ Infer timing and grooming only; no comment on appearance, no personality reading
- **face.pillow-crease**: A crease down one cheek with the hair flattened on the same side → Just woke up, sleeping on that side (strong); Napped face-down on a desk (medium)
- **face.goggle-ring**: A ring of pressure marks around the eye sockets → Just out of the pool, or just removed safety goggles (strong)
- **face.headphone-ear-marks**: A dent along the top of the ear, or a channel pressed into the hair around it → Hours in over-ear headphones: desk work, editing, support, gaming (medium)
- **face.wind-flush**: Wind-burnt cheeks and nose with a pale patch where eyewear sat → Recent hours in wind: skiing, cycling, coast, high altitude (medium)

## hair

- **hair.regrowth-band**: A band of different colour at the roots → Time since the last colour: hair grows roughly a centimetre a month (strong)
- **hair.hat-crease**: A ring pressed all the way around the hair → Just took off a hat that had been on for hours (strong)
- **hair.fresh-cut-neckline**: A razor-sharp neckline with cut hairs still on the collar → Haircut within a day or two (strong)
- **hair.tie-dent**: A horizontal kink where a hair tie sat → Just let tied-up hair down (medium); Tied up most of the day: sport, kitchen, lab, childcare (medium)

## clothing

- **clothing.rolled-one-trouser-leg**: One trouser leg rolled up, on the chain side → Commutes by bicycle; keeps the cuff out of the chain (strong)
- **clothing.lanyard-badge**: A lanyard, access badge, or a strap worn pale with use → Daily access-controlled workplace: campus, hospital, school, plant (strong)
- **clothing.event-badge-left-on**: A conference badge, race bib, or wristband still on → Straight from the event, not home yet (strong)
- **clothing.cuff-wear**: Sleeve cuffs pilled, shiny, or worn thin on the inside → Long hours at a desk with the forearm dragging on the edge (medium); A garment worn often and for years (medium)
  - source: The Red-Headed League
- **clothing.fold-creases-new**: Factory fold lines still crossing the garment → Straight out of the packaging, first wear (strong); Pulled from a suitcase on a trip (medium)
- **clothing.sitting-wrinkles**: Dense horizontal creases across the thighs, smooth at the waist → Just sat for hours: long commute, meetings, driving (medium)
- **clothing.pet-hair**: Short pale hairs on dark clothing, concentrated on the thighs and chest → Lives with a cat (fine hair, mostly on the chest) or a dog (mostly on the legs) (strong)
- **clothing.race-shirt**: A race, marathon, conference or club shirt → Took part in that event and is happy to signal it (strong); A gift, or a family member took part (weak)
- **clothing.shoulder-wear-one-side**: Wear, sag or fading on one shoulder only → Carries a bag on one shoulder, always the same one (medium)
- **clothing.workwear-details**: Reflective strips, reinforced knees, tool pockets, or anti-static fabric → A job needing visibility or durability: site, logistics, repair, cleanroom (medium); Style choice: workwear as fashion (medium)
- **clothing.right-cuff-shine**: Five inches of shine on the right cuff, and a worn patch at the left elbow → Writes by hand for hours: right wrist on the desk, left elbow propped (strong)
  - applies to: historical case · source: The Red-Headed League

## accessories

- **accessories.watch-on-right**: Watch worn on the right wrist → Left-handed: the watch goes on the non-dominant wrist (medium); The dominant hand rests on surfaces or wears gloves (medium)
  - ⚠️ The photo may be mirrored (front-camera selfie): confirm left from right before concluding
- **accessories.fitness-band**: A fitness band or sports watch with a sweat-stained, worn strap → Trains on a schedule and tracks it, often overnight too (medium)
- **accessories.phone-case-cards**: Cards tucked into the phone case, or an access sticker on the back → More than one card to tap daily: door, transit, canteen (medium); Goes out without a wallet (medium)
  - applies to: mainland China / East Asia
- **accessories.cracked-corner-screen**: A spiderweb crack in one corner of a phone screen, still in use → Dropped it and chose not to fix it: budget, hassle, or upgrading soon (medium)
  - ⚠️ Never infer income or financial circumstances
- **accessories.many-fobs**: A key ring loaded with several fobs, locker tags, or a carabiner → Regularly enters several places: office, gym, shared flat, family home (medium); A carabiner suggests outdoor habits leaking into daily carry (weak)
- **accessories.pawn-scratches**: Pawnbroker ticket numbers scratched inside a watch case → The watch was pawned and redeemed more than once (strong)
  - applies to: historical case · source: The Sign of Four
  - ⚠️ In the story this was right and still hurt Watson: being correct is not permission to say it. On money, either stay silent or name the event, never the circumstances

## shoes

- **shoes.trail-residue**: Dried mud, seeds or sand in the sidewall and tread → Recently off pavement: hiking, site, trail, wet ground (strong)
  - source: A Study in Scarlet
- **shoes.heel-crushed**: Heel counters crushed flat from being stepped on → Slips them on and off constantly: in and out, works from home, shoes-off spaces (medium)
  - applies to: East Asia
- **shoes.pristine-vs-worn**: Uppers barely creased and soles hardly worn → Bought recently (medium); Drives or rides everywhere; very few steps a day (medium); One of several pairs in rotation (medium)
- **shoes.sport-specific**: Sport-specific shoes: carbon-plate racers, climbing shoes, court shoes, cleats → Trains that sport seriously rather than casually (strong)
- **shoes.heel-outer-wear**: Heels worn on the outer edge → Toes-out gait; walks a lot (medium)
  - ⚠️ Heavy wear on one side only: never turn this into a health inference

## posture

- **posture.desk-set**: Head slightly forward and shoulders rounded, settling into a hunch when seated → Many hours a day in front of a screen (medium)
  - ⚠️ A habit, not a diagnosis: no illness, pain or treatment inferences
- **posture.trained-stance**: Stands square and upright, hands at the sides, turns crisply → Drilled posture: military or police, dance, marching band, cabin crew (medium)
  - source: Joseph Bell
- **posture.army-doctor-composite**: Military bearing, a face tanned but pale wrists, a stiffly held left arm, and a medical manner → An army doctor wounded in the tropics: four weak signals crossing, none sufficient alone (strong)
  - applies to: historical case · source: A Study in Scarlet
  - ⚠️ This is the crossing pattern: the force comes from four independent marks pointing the same way

## body

- **body.sleeve-tan-line**: A T-shirt tan line on the upper arm with a clear break at the wrist → Lots of outdoor time in short sleeves: cycling, field sport, site work, running (strong)
- **body.glove-line**: Tanned backs of the hands with pale fingers, edged like a glove → Fingerless gloves outdoors: cycling, rowing, lifting, racquet sports (strong)
- **body.wrist-tan**: Tanned face, no tan above the wrists → Wore long-sleeved uniform outdoors or in the tropics (strong)
  - applies to: historical case · source: A Study in Scarlet
- **body.hat-not-removed**: Keeps hat on indoors, carries authority → Recently discharged NCO: army habits not yet unlearned (strong)
  - applies to: historical case · source: Joseph Bell
- **body.travel-tattoo**: A tattoo shaded with a technique practised in only one part of the world → Has been there, or lived inside that community (medium)

  - ⚠️ Infer only that they have been there, never ethnicity, nationality or immigration status
